title: First-time Application of IASs as the Primary Basis of Accounting
summary: Addressed how an entity adopting IASs for the first time should apply them, generally requiring retrospective application. Superseded in 2003 by IFRS 1.

related.title: First-time Adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards
related.relationship: The comprehensive first-time adoption standard that entirely superseded SIC-8 in 2003
